description: Find recommendations for an AniList media ID. source anilist (default) pages AniList community recommendations and adds matching MAL vote counts when available. source jikan deduplicates the list supplied by Jikan using maximum votes, sorts by votes descending then MAL ID ascending, pages those candidates locally, and resolves up to 25 selected IDs through AniList; adult and unresolved candidates are omitted without changing candidate pagination. Jikan pages do not guarantee a global ranking or a snapshot across calls. Check source, jikan_status and has_next_page; repeat the same source, id and per_page with the next page to continue. Ratings and vote counts stay separate. Selected-source failures require retrying or switching to anilist; optional annotation failure is reported as unavailable.

id.description: AniList media ID of the title to get recommendations for.

liked_aspects.description: What you liked about this title, such as the slow-burn romance or mecha action. Returned as-is in the response.

page.description: 1-based page number within the selected source; Jikan pages its supplied list locally.

per_page.description: Recommendations per AniList page or Jikan candidates per local page before adult/unresolved omissions. Maximum 25.

source.description: Recommendation source and paging strategy. AniList pages its recommendations; Jikan locally pages its supplied candidate list.

name: anime_get_recommendations

cap.description: The per-page limit applied. Present alongside truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: AniList has no media record for the requested source ID. `jikan_unavailable`: The selected Jikan recommendation source is unavailable. `resolution_unavailable`: AniList could not resolve the selected Jikan candidates. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The complete recommendation operation exceeds its shared time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether the selected source has another page. Jikan follows candidate slicing even when selected candidates do not resolve.

jikan_status.description: Whether Jikan supplied its list, failed as an optional supplement, or the source has no MAL mapping.

liked_aspects.description: Liked aspects provided by the caller, or null.

notice.description: Next-page guidance. Present only when the recommendations page was capped.

recommendations.description: Recommendations in selected-source order: AniList rating descending, or Jikan maximum votes descending then MAL ID ascending. Jikan-only pages omit adult/unresolved candidates and retain sources jikan with null anilist_rating.

anilist_rating.description: AniList community recommendation rating. Higher = more recommended.

id.description: AniList media ID of the recommended title.

id_mal.description: MAL ID of the recommended title, or null.

jikan_votes.description: MAL user recommendation vote count, or null when not in Jikan results.

items.description: A source that includes this recommendation.

shown.description: Number of recommendations returned on this page. Present alongside truncated.

source_id.description: AniList ID of the source title.

source_id_mal.description: MAL ID of the source title, or null.

source_type.description: Source media type: ANIME or MANGA.

truncated.description: True when this page of recommendations was capped at per_page. Present only when the cap was hit.

title: Anime Get Recommendations
